tools.name: search_empty_legs
tools.description: Finds current empty-leg flights by origin and/or destination (city, IATA/ICAO code, country, US state, region or area such as Greek Islands), dates, passengers, budget and aircraft class. Returns up to 20 offers with route, date, aircraft, seats, indicative price, a voidjet link and a pre-filled inq

tools.name: get_empty_leg
tools.description: Current details of one offer by the ref returned by search_empty_legs. available=false means the offer is no longer listed.

tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: Returns voidjet's own answers to questions about costs, costs before a binding contract, contract partner, what happens after an inquiry, price binding, cancelled empty legs, how voidjet is funded, who receives the user's data and how fast providers reply. Use it instead of guessing. No information

tools.name: report_unmet_need
tools.description: Records a need voidjet cannot serve, for when the user wants voidjet to know about it: e.g. no offer on the route, a return flight, pets, instant booking. Takes 1-5 categories and optional route, dates, passengers and budget; no personal data. Helps voidjet decide what to add.

tools.name: request_inquiry
tools.description: Prepares an inquiry for one offer, for when the user has asked to inquire and given their email. voidjet emails the user a link; nothing is forwarded to the provider until the user opens it and sends the pre-filled form on voidjet.io within 48 hours. name, phone and message are optional, come from t

tools.name: request_charter_quote
tools.description: Requests confirmed charter prices from partner Villiers for the route of a charter_alternative, for when the user has seen its price range, asked for confirmed prices and given their email. NOT an empty leg: a regular charter; voidjet receives a fee from the partner. voidjet emails the user a link;

tools.name: create_flight_alert
tools.description: Sets up an email alert for new empty legs on a route or from a place, for when the user asks to be notified and gives their email. voidjet emails a confirmation link; the alert becomes active only after the user clicks it (double opt-in, valid 7 days). Needs origin or destination; dates, passengers
